title: AcademicKnowledgeItemContract
description: Contract schema for persistent learned domain knowledge items, capturing generalized rules, applicability constraints, exclusions, and provenance.

knowledge_id.description: Unique identifier for this knowledge item (e.g. KNW-STAT-ANCOVA-SLOPE-001).

statement.description: Canonical scholarly or methodological knowledge statement.

generalization_stage.description: Current position on the 7-stage generalization ladder.

project_id.description: Optional project ID when scope is project or global-in-project.

domain.description: Optional research or methodological domain (e.g. mediation, sem, psychometrics).

capability.description: Optional capability identifier associated with this knowledge item.

target_agent.description: Optional subagent role to which this knowledge item is strictly targeted.

target_agents.description: List of subagent roles to which this knowledge item applies.

criteria.description: Conditions under which this knowledge item applies.

exclusions.description: Explicit counter-indications or conditions where this rule MUST NOT be applied.

source_lessons.description: IDs of source lessons from which this knowledge was synthesized.

supporting_evaluations.description: Evaluation IDs or benchmark cases empirically verifying this knowledge.

contradictions.description: Explicit documentation of rejected counter-paradigms (e.g. Baron & Kenny vs Bootstrap).

relationships.description: Explicit relational links to other knowledge, lessons, anti-patterns, evaluations, or skills.

tags.description: Topical and methodological keywords for fast indexing and query retrieval.

confidence.description: Statistical or epistemic confidence in this knowledge item (0.0 to 1.0).

confidence_evidence.description: Evidence factors supporting the computed confidence score.

curated_by.description: Authoritative role or gatekeeper who validated the knowledge (e.g. digital-saber, final-judge).
